6aaadf258cc64f2b2b7dbe3c: The girls encounter a couple named Mitsuo and Yukiko who are searching for their missing daughter Miku.
Vice Principal Mishima learns from the rescued Tanizaki about a man known as the Delivery Man believed to be their leader.
The Coppelion succeed in bringing down the monster crow, which then crash-lands in one of the Zones.
While heading to their next destination, the girls encounter a father and his pregnant daughter being attacked by a group of armed men.
Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: Shakles
The release of Sakazawa's notes about the Beast Phenomenon stokes further panic to the city.
Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: Corpses
Beasts that had been defeated by Jun reappear in front of her to attack her once again.
Go Nagai's The Devil Lady: Signs
A national vaccination has been obligated to the citizens in an attempt to prevent Beast Phenomenon from further spreading.
Kage Hoshi reveals the truth of Recca's birth.
Recca is troubled by his origins.
Recca must train for his next battle.
Recca receives a spot in the Underground Death Tournament.
Team Hokage, led by Recca, must face off against a group of bandit killers.
Domon takes his turn in the ring.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 1

Jotaro and his friends finally land in Egypt, where DIO awaits, and are cutting through the desert when a helicopter approaches. The helicopter belongs to the Speedwagon Foundation and is there to make a special delivery requested by Joseph.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Iggy the Fool and Geb's N'doul, Part 2
Jotaro and crew acquire the help of Iggy but are ambushed by a water Stand. With Kakyoin injured, Avdol tries out a stratagem which the unseen enemy quickly sees through. Meanwhile, Iggy is napping.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Khnum's Zenyatta and Thoth's Mondatta
After the battle with N'doul, Kakyoin and Avdol are badly hurt, so the group heads for a hospital in Aswan. Unfortunately, dangerous enemies could be all around them even there.

A young man named Chaka finds a mysterious sword on the beach. Though other men try, Chaka is the only one who can draw it. The sword claims Chaka as its master and sends the youth in pursuit of Jotaro and his friends with deadly intent.

Having defeated the "Anubis" Stand user Chaka, Polnareff pays a visit to a barber. But when the barber starts attacking him with Chaka's sword, the Frenchman realizes the sword itself is the Stand user.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bast's Mariah, Part 1

On the way to Luxor, Joseph notices an electrical outlet set in a rock. Fascinated by the rare sight, Joseph goes in for a closer look and gets shocked. Though he seems fine afterward, soon all manner of small accidents begin to occur around him.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bast's Mariah, Part 2

Due to the powers of an enemy Stand, Joseph's body becomes magnetized. While chasing after the woman he suspects is the Stand user, Joseph learns that Avdol has also become magnetized from touching a different electrical outlet.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Set's Alessi, Part 1

With Joseph and Avdol busy fighting Mariah, Jotaro and Polnareff get concerned about why they haven't shown up yet. As the two search Luxor, Polnareff senses someone following them and confronts the man.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Set's Alessi, Part 2

The power of Alessi's Stand "Set" has turned Polnareff back into a child, leaving him confused and alone. A passerby named Marena takes the boy into her home to help him, but they are followed by Alessi and his terrible powers.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Gambler, Part 1

After a long journey, Jotaro and his friends finally reach Cairo. They begin asking about the location of DIO's palace and find one man who says he has information, but will only answer if the group can beat him in a game.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Gambler, Part 2

After losing to D'Arby, Joseph and Polnareff have their souls taken. In order to have their souls returned, Jotaro shows off Star Platinum's powers before beginning a match with D'Arby, warning him that cheating won't work.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Hol Horse and Mondatta, Part 1

Hol Horse arrives at Cairo in order to pursue Jotaro and the others. He has joined forces with another partner and is after the lives of Jotaro and crew once more. What's more, his new partner is none other than Mondatta.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Hol Horse and Mondatta, Part 2

Following Mondatta's prediction, Hol Horse sticks his fingers into Polnareff's nose, but he doesn't know what to do from there. Making matters worse, Jotaro and the others show up in search of Polnareff, forcing Hol Horse into a tough spot.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 1

Jotaro and his friends continue to search for DIO's mansion in Cairo. Following Avdol's advice, they have a beggar look for the mansion and wait. Meanwhile, Iggy, wandering the city alone, is confronted by two large dogs.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Guardian of Hell, Pet Shop, Part 2

Iggy ends up in a battle to the death in the sewers against Pet Shop, the falcon that guards DIO's mansion. Despite being injured, Iggy runs to the river in an attempt to escape, but he may have underestimated Pet Shop's abilities.
JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: D'Arby the Player, Part 1

Though purchased dearly with Iggy's injury, Jotaro and his group finally have the location of DIO's palace. Waiting for them where they find the butler, Darby Younger, brother of the gambler they previously defeated.
As the battle with the Deep Sea King reaches its climax, more heroes fall to the aquatic despot's brutal attacks.
